subject: Oxbridge Pilot: Integration matrix & success plan
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Wong <awong@oxbridge.ai>, Samira Khan <samira.k@oxbridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Oxbridge Pilot: Integration matrix & success plan

Thanks again for the call this morning — good alignment on goals. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we all have the same plan. Please flag anything I missed.

Summary of objective
- Run a 4-week pilot to validate latency and accuracy for clinical triage use case across 3 endpoints (symptom intake, triage recommendation, note synthesis).

Success criteria (must / nice-to-have)
- MUST: 95th percentile latency < 250ms for single-turn inference at target batch sizes; end-to-end triage accuracy within 5% of your current baseline per the evaluation set you shared.
- NICE: streaming responses for note synthesis (partial tokens) with smooth playback; tool-calling support for our custom triage lookup (external API).

Scope & deliverables
- Redwood to provide a dedicated trial instance (isolated tenant) + standard SDKs for REST and streaming.
- Oxbridge to provide the de-identified eval set and sample API for triage lookup (or a sandbox endpoint).
- Jointly run 3 scripted evaluation runs (baseline, mid-pilot, final) and one performance soak test.

Timeline (proposed)
- Week 0 (Nov 30): Kickoff + infra access and share credentials/keys.
- Week 1: SDK integration + smoke tests (endpoints /v1/generate, /v1/stream, tool-calling flow).
- Week 2: Data ingestion + initial eval run.
- Week 3: Tuning and performance run.
- Week 4: Final evaluation & handoff + results review.

Ownership (initial)
- Redwood: Ben Carter (AM) owner for project / contract; Marissa Cole (Solutions Engineer) owns SDK onboarding and streaming tests; Monica Patel (Customer Success) will run evaluation scripts and coordinate runs.
- Oxbridge: Alex Wong (Eng) will own sandbox API and data handoff; Samira Khan (Clinical Ops) will validate accuracy metrics.

Immediate asks
1) Alex — please confirm you can share a de-identified eval set and a sandbox triage API by Nov 29.
2) Samira — confirm the accuracy metric you want us to use (top-1 recommendation or rank-based).
3) Marissa — can you draft the integration checklist and call out any blockers for streaming & tool-calling?

Attachments: initial POC map spreadsheet (oxbridge-poc-map.xlsx) and sample data (oxbridge-data-sample.json).

Thanks — I’ll schedule a short kickoff (30m) on Nov 30 unless you prefer a different day.

—
Ben Carter

Thanks Ben — this is perfect and captures our conversation. Quick clarifications: 

- We can provide a de-identified eval set (CSV + JSON schema) by COB Nov 28; I'll have the engineering team strip PHI.
- Sandbox triage API: we can expose a read-only endpoint that mirrors the prod lookup (token-based) — ETA Nov 29. Will that suffice for your tool-calling tests?
- Accuracy metric: prefer rank-based scoring for recommendations (MAP@5) plus a pass/fail for top-1 clinical correctness (reviewed by Samira).

Two asks from our side: 
1) Can you confirm which SDK languages you'll test (we plan Node + Python)?
2) Do you provide a streaming example showing partial token consumption + reconnection behavior? That’s a risk area for us.

I’ll sign the SOW as soon as we have the kickoff schedule. Attaching our sample payload expectations (oxbridge-data-sample.json).

On the kickoff: Nov 30 at 10:00 PT works for Alex; Samira may need 11:00 PT. Either fine — we can pick 10:30 PT if that works.

Thanks Ben — I’ll take point on the evaluation harness and timelines. Below is an initial implementation matrix and owner list; will push a detailed runbook to the Drive by EOD Nov 28.

Implementation matrix (high level)
- SDK onboarding (Marissa) — Node + Python: validate /v1/generate (sync), /v1/stream (streaming SSE/ws), and /v1/toolcall (json roundtrip). Deliverable: working examples + README. Due: Dec 4 (internal dry run).
- Sandbox & auth (Ben) — temporary API token and IP allowlist for Oxbridge sandbox. Deliverable: token + sandbox endpoint. Due: Nov 30 (kickoff).
- Data ingestion & eval harness (Monica) — ingestion script, normalization, MAP@5 scorer, top-1 clinical correctness reviewer flow. Deliverable: harness repo + test artifacts. Due: Dec 7 (final run).
- Performance testing (Marissa + Monica) — soak test to capture P95 and memory behavior at target batch sizes. Deliverable: perf report. Due: Dec 11.

Technical notes / integration details
- API surface: we will exercise /v1/generate (POST JSON payload with messages + system instructions), /v1/stream (SSE with chunked token frames), and /v1/toolcall (POST to /v1/toolcall with tool id and arguments; Redwood returns a tool result object).
- Streaming behavior: client must reconnect with last-received token index; server supports idempotent resumes for up to 30s. Marissa — please include reconnection code in the examples.
- Auth: OAuth2 bearer for SDKs; token rotation supported. For the sandbox we will issue a time-limited token and deliver via secure Drive link.

Next steps
1) Ben — schedule kickoff for Nov 30 10:30 PT and share calendar invite + initial sandbox token (temp).
2) Marissa — drop SDK streaming demos and tool-calling checklist in Drive by Nov 29.
3) Alex/Samira — legal: please review the redline-nda.pdf and signal any showstoppers.

Happy to sync on a short tech call (15m) post-kickoff for any deep streaming questions.

—
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
